context: Converts MapTile height and biome data into renderable terrain meshes with appropriate material and LOD settings.
description: Builds landscape or Nanite meshes for each loaded tile and applies Runtime Virtual Texturing (RVT) for texture blending; ensures continuity across tiles and zoom levels.

classes.name: TerrainRenderer
classes.description: Component that generates render assets for MapTiles.

methods.name: BuildMesh(tile)
methods.description: Create a mesh or landscape section from the tile's height field.
methods.pseudocode: Sample tile.heightField into a vertex grid; create mesh; apply normal mapping; adjust resolution based on tile.lodLevel.

methods.name: ApplyMaterials(tile)
methods.description: Assign materials based on biome and slope using RVT or tri‑planar techniques.
methods.pseudocode: For each vertex: compute biome index; choose material layers (grass, rock, sand); blend using slope and altitude; write to RVT.

methods.name: UpdateLOD(tile)
methods.description: Update the mesh's LOD or HLOD representation when the camera zoom changes.
methods.pseudocode: Switch between full mesh, simplified mesh or impostor depending on distance and tile.lodLevel.

pseudocode: For each loaded tile: build a mesh at an appropriate resolution; assign materials and update LOD when needed.
